text:
Lina: Heads-up — AWS Marketplace + NovaSystems (SI) are planning a joint announcement next quarter. Need to lock rules for lead stamping, ownership handoffs, and how we surface marketplace leads to Nova.
Raj: +1. main questions: when does a lead become Nova-owned vs Redwood-owned?
Emma: My proposal: stamp to Nova if the account match meets both: (1) >$100k ARR or strategic vertical, and (2) Nova had pre-sales intro or co-demo. Otherwise Redwood owns.
Mike: How do we capture "pre-sales intro" in the CRM reliably? Historically that field is flaky.
Alex: We should use a tag pattern: `partner:novasys-intro` and require the tag plus meeting record in SFDC within 30 days. Automation can sweep for missing fields.
Sarah-W: Also consider marketplace-originated signals: if the lead originated from AWS Marketplace listing (utm=aws-marketplace) and was triaged by Nova via our intake flow, then Nova gets priority routing.
Lina: Good — so three signal buckets: Nova-intro tag, marketplace-origin + Nova triage, and high-value strategic accounts. Which overrides which?
Raj: Override order: Nova-intro tag > marketplace-origin+triage > high-value. Rationale: if Nova did the heavy lift, they should own even if account is large.
Emma: Agree but add a cap: if Redwood has an active contract negotiation (deal stage >= Proposal) we should not reassign without SDR+AE sync. Avoid mid-funnel stomps.
Mike: Can we show this as a simple decision matrix? I can make a quick view for the intake dashboard.
Alex: Pseudo-rule for automation:
```
if has_tag('partner:novasys-intro') and meeting_with_partner within 30d => owner = Nova
else if lead_source == 'aws-marketplace' and partner_triaged == true => owner = Nova
else if ARR >= 100000 and not in_deal_stage('proposal','contract') => owner = Nova
else => owner = Redwood
```
Sarah-W: Add an exception: if the account is in Redwood's named accounts list (NAMED=true), then do not auto-assign to Nova unless sales exec approves.
Lina: Good catch. Also need an escalation path: Nova thinks they own but Redwood disagrees. Proposed steps: 1) tag + DM SME, 2) 24hr SLA for dispute, 3) if unresolved, handoff review meeting weekly.
Raj: Can partnerships-bot surface disputed claims into the #partnerships-disputes channel? That would make audit easier.
partnerships-bot: automated note — will post new disputed-claim threads to #partnerships-disputes and add `dispute:open` tag in CRM when API flag set. :robot_face:
Emma: For joint announcement accounts (the ones in the press list), we need manual confirm — no automation. Those are always reviewed by GTM and legal before assignment.
Mike: Implementation ask for eng: expose two boolean fields in intake API: `partner_triaged` and `partner_intro_tag` (string). Also webhook when marketplace utm detected.
Alex: I'll create the intake PR and include SFDC mapping: tag -> custom field, `lead_source_detail` = utm_medium. Will include sample mutation for the webhook.
Lina: Timeline: engineering PR by Tue, automation rules in staging by Friday, partners ops playbook draft by EOD Friday. Who owns the playbook?
Sarah-W: I'll draft the playbook (handshake steps + templates) and send for review.
Raj: I'll coordinate with Nova and AWS PMs to confirm triage expectations.
Emma: Small note — let's include a short boilerplate for email intros to partners so the tag creation step isn't missed.
Lina: Awesome. Final ask: anyone object to these rules? speak now or we'll lock and pilot on the marketplace launch.
Mike: No objections from eng.
Alex: 👍
Sarah-W: All good.
Raj: No objections, will surface any partner concerns.
Lina: OK locking. Thanks everyone — I'll add the doc to the partnership playbook and ping when PR is up. :tada:
